items.title: Lock no-overlap scope and generated metadata manifest
items.context: Implement only the new automation layer. Consume B-eb08/B-eb92/B-b264 outputs; do not add heartbeat labels, review-assurance surfacing, or rerun-delta prose. Add a current-run generated metadata manifest for done_prepare.
items.userSees: The story scope says this is opt-in auto-closeout only, and done_prepare can identify files generated by this run.

happy.desc: A done_prepare fixture records a current-run generated metadata manifest for DONE-required and test evidence files.

edge.desc: Pre-existing lifecycle metadata dirt is not classified as current-run generated metadata.

adversarial.desc: The implementation adds no new heartbeat labels, review-assurance guidance, or rerun-delta explanation strings owned by B-eb08/B-eb92/B-b264.

verificationEvidence.note: assertManifestOnlyAutoCloseout verifies the current-run manifest captures done-required-evidence.json and test-evidence.json and commits exactly those files.
assertPreexistingLifecycleMetadataIsUnsafe verifies pre-existing test-evidence.json dirt is unsafe_preexisting_dirty and not current-run generated metadata.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --unified=0 main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-validation-reuse.ts | rg added heartbeat/review/rerun strings
verificationEvidence.note: No implementation additions match done_prepare progress labels, review-assurance guidance, rerun-delta, or merge-preflight strings; this story stays on auto-closeout scope.

items.title: Add opt-in safe auto-commit for manifest-only lifecycle metadata
items.context: Add an explicit flag or mode that stages and commits only the current-run generated Proofbound lifecycle metadata manifest. Refuse on unrelated dirty files, runtime/source/doc changes, unsafe paths, deletes, renames, or missing manifest.
items.userSees: done_prepare auto-closeout prints the generated metadata commit sha and exact files, or refuses with unsafe paths before committing.

happy.desc: Opt-in auto-closeout commits only current-run generated lifecycle metadata with a deterministic message.

edge.desc: Unrelated modified docs, untracked files, runtime changes, deleted files, and unsafe renames block before any commit.

adversarial.desc: The command never runs broad git add, stash, checkout, reset, clean, push, publish, or release operations.

verificationEvidence.note: assertManifestOnlyAutoCloseout verifies opt-in auto-closeout creates the deterministic auto-close commit and the commit contains only done-required-evidence.json and test-evidence.json.
Smoke covers unsafe docs side effect before reuse metadata and helper classifications for pre-existing dirt, deletes, and renames as unsafe with no safe auto-stage paths.

installCommandSpy asserts auto-closeout never uses git push, stash, reset, clean, checkout, switch, --no-verify, release, publish, delivery_check_set, review_pass_set, quorum_submit, or authority operations.

items.title: Reuse validation only for proven metadata-only HEAD drift
items.context: After the safe metadata commit, skip full validate only when materialHash, storyFilesHash, validation commandSetHash, DONE-required commandSetHash, and policyHash all match prior PASS evidence. Otherwise run or require normal validation.
items.userSees: done_prepare reports validation reused because material/storyFiles/command/policy hashes are unchanged, or reports why full validation is required.

happy.desc: Metadata-only HEAD drift reuses fresh validation and does not execute the full configured validate command list.

edge.desc: Material edits, storyFiles changes, validation config changes, policy changes, or stale DONE-required evidence force normal validation or a hard blocker.

adversarial.desc: Reuse records preserve the prior command transcript and never pretend validation commands were rerun.

verificationEvidence.note: assertManifestOnlyAutoCloseout verifies validationReused=true after metadata-only auto-closeout and commandsRerunAfterAutoCloseout=false.
assertMissingHashesRefuseReuse and assertReuseRefusesConfigAndMaterialDrift prove missing hashes, material drift, validate command drift, DONE-required command drift, and config drift refuse reuse.
Smoke asserts the reuse record says not rerun, commandsRerunAfterAutoCloseout=false, and priorEvidenceRefs preserve the validate command and DONE-required receipt digest.

items.title: Re-evaluate DONE prepare after safe auto-closeout without auto-advancing DONE
items.context: After a safe metadata commit and validation reuse, re-run DONE closure, runtime-change, and clean-tree projection. Return PASS or canonical blockers, but do not call story_advance DONE by default.
items.userSees: The opt-in command reaches DONE prepare PASS and prints the next legal story_advance command when no real blocker remains.

happy.desc: A fixture that previously needed done_prepare -> commit -> done_prepare now reaches PASS in one opt-in command.

edge.desc: Missing review assurance remains blocked and uses canonical B-eb92/B-b264 guidance without auto-writing verdicts.

adversarial.desc: The command does not auto-advance DONE, auto-bump versions, push, publish, claim Authority DONE, or claim production readiness.

verificationEvidence.note: assertManifestOnlyAutoCloseout verifies one opt-in done_prepare reaches PASS after auto-closeout and prints the next legal story_advance DONE command.
review-assurance-surfacing smoke verifies missing review assurance remains a done_prepare doneClosure blocker with canonical owner-runnable guidance instead of auto-writing verdicts.

installCommandSpy and delivery-check byte comparison prove done_prepare auto-closeout does not auto-advance DONE, bump versions, push, publish, claim Authority or production readiness, or self-sign delivery/review evidence.

items.title: Add regression coverage for safety and JSON cleanliness
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage for success, refusal cases, validation reuse, JSON parseability, no auto-signing, and no remote/publish behavior. Wire it into package scripts without expanding unrelated validate surfaces.
items.userSees: The focused smoke passes and proves auto-closeout is opt-in, narrow, parseable, and fail-closed.

edge.desc: JSON stdout remains parseable and human progress/guidance stays on the safe side channel.

adversarial.desc: No review, host, delivery, fallback, Authority, release, production, or remote evidence is auto-written.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-auto-closeout-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD build and done-prepare-auto-closeout smoke both pass.
assertJsonStdoutClean verifies JSON stdout parses, contains no progress or auto-closeout side-channel text, and progress remains on stderr.
installCommandSpy and delivery-check byte comparison prove no review, host, delivery, fallback, Authority, release, production, remote, publish, or push evidence is auto-written.
